description: Check the project's setup in one pass: Node, debuff package versions, node_modules, debuff.config.ts, assets, saves.json, agent files and the browser. Every check has an id, ok, a message and a fix; ok is false only when a required check failed. Call it when another tool fails on setup. live: true also starts the dev server and waits for the game's dev hooks (about 5 to 15 s).

live.description: Also boot the game and check its dev hooks. Default false.

root.description: Project root. Absolute path, or relative to the server's root. Default: the server's root.

name: doctor
title: Check setup
